blocks.text: British-Norwegian pop group A1 shared the story behind its new single, “In Love in the Philippines,” during a press conference at Waterfront Cebu City Hotel & Casino, Cebu City, on October 15, 2026, ahead of the group’s Cebu concert on October 16, 2026. The song marks the first time the band has written a track about a country, inspired by years of returning to the Philippines and connecting with Filipino fans whose support has extended beyond the country’s borders.
